description: Lists Compute Engine instance templates. Details for each instance template include name, ID, description, machine type, region, and creation timestamp. Requires project as input.

inputSchema.description: Request message for listing instance templates basic info.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of instance templates to return.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous call to list instance templates.

project.description: Required. Project ID for this request.

name: list_instance_templates

InstanceTemplateBasicInfo.description: InstanceTemplateBasicInfo contains basic information about an instance template.

createTime.description: Creation timestamp of the instance template.

id.description: The unique identifier for the instance template.

machineType.description: The machine type of the instance template.

region.description: The region of the instance template if it is a regional resource.

outputSchema.description: Response message for listing instance templates basic info.

nextPageToken.description: A token that can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.
